name: Sparse Voxelization with Hierarchical LoD
aliases: Fast Voxelization and Level of Detail for Microgeometry Rendering
definition: A voxelization pipeline designed for high-frequency sparse geometric objects (fibers, hair, thin planes) that processes volumetric data into multiple Levels of Detail (LoD), preserving appearance information by separating geometric/directional data from material properties.
summary: Sparse Voxelization with Hierarchical LoD is a voxelization pipeline for high-frequency sparse geometry that preserves appearance by separating directional data from materials using SGGX histogram fitting.
